badges.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. Convert the attached approved design board into a TRANSPARENT SPRITE ATLAS of its SEVEN achievement badges. Keep the existing badge artwork faithfully: same creatures, tools, shapes, palettes, gradients and arrangement WITHIN each badge. Do not redesign. Remove ALL Japanese text, headings, paper cards, board background, footer, outer decorative bubbles and the unearned faded example.
Layout: exactly FOUR equal columns, TWO equal rows, generous transparent gutters and 8% margin inside each cell. Top row: 1 explorer dolphin sorting bottle into blue bin with coral second bin and small flag, 2 turtle holding net on turquoise shield, 3 dolphin with graduation cap over purple open book, 4 yellow 100-point smiling star and ribbon. Bottom row: 1 hermit crab holding the same mint magnifier with shell/bottle in lens, 2 coral rosette with silver two-arm TONGS pinching a wrapper, 3 mint heart frame containing central pink heart ENCIRCLED by dolphin upper-left, turtle upper-right, hermit bottom-center. Bottom-right cell completely EMPTY transparent.
Keep the numeral 100 ONLY inside the star; no other text anywhere. Preserve warm ivory/gold contour rims and soft enamel gloss exactly. Include only connected badge art, remove loose external sparkles/droplets so each badge is a single isolated connected silhouette, not multiple floating components. Real transparent alpha including the gutters; no checkerboard, floor or drop shadows. Every badge uncropped and centered in its cell at comparable size. Production game assets matching the approved image, not a new proposal.

sorting.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. Convert the attached APPROVED beach sorting design board into a game sprite atlas with real TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Retain all three bins and all SIX litter objects exactly as depicted, including their shapes, colors, highlights and symbols. Do not redesign or simplify. Remove ALL text, page headings, footer, colored cards, scenery, decorative shells/stars/waves outside objects, and floor shadows.
Layout EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas. Generous transparent gutters, every object contained within its own equal square cell with 10% padding. One connected isolated object per cell.
ROW1 left to right: BLUE plastic bin with white bottle/bag marks; YELLOW can/glass bin with white can/bottle marks; CORAL burnable bin with WHITE ROPE-COIL and TWIG marks. Keep each bin's ivory broad open lip, large visible dark opening, side handles, feet and little wave pattern along its base. All same scale, same three-quarter perspective.
ROW2 left to right: blue-capped PET plastic bottle; pale blue rumpled loop-handle shopping bag; dented silver can with yellow band.
ROW3 left to right: amber glass bottle; brown Y-shaped driftwood twig; BLUE coiled rope with two short ends.
Do NOT include paper, paper icon, names, white rectangular patches behind items, faces, extra objects or shadows. Match the approved drawing faithfully. The shopping bag and rope holes must be genuinely transparent. The bin openings remain dark colored interior, not transparent. No checkerboard background. Clean cutout alpha edges, no floating stray speckles.
